oneLiner: Fantasy football for the Billboard charts, refereed by GenLayer.
description: Hot Roster is a fantasy music league for 4–8 friends. Draft five songs, play weekly head-to-head matches and earn code-calculated Hot 100 points. GenLayer validators match recordings against extracted chart rows, judge moment cards and interpret disputes against a hashed rulebook with verbatim evidence. Five contracts separate judgment, league scoring and optional GEN pools. The public six-week StudioNet season includes awarded and rejected cards, upheld disputes and all 40 entry wei credited. A second four-player, four-week league demonstrates a custom lead-credit rule: the generic reader matches Fortnight under featured artist Post Malone, the Court overturns that match, and code rescores it to zero and returns the three-point bond. That case sends no GEN deposits. The strict read-only verifier checks finalized receipts, deployed sources, chart digests, standings, both dispute outcomes and native payouts. Simulated StudioNet GEN only.

howTo.heading: Inspect the recorded season
howTo.instruction: Open the website without a wallet. Inspect standings, choose a roster and select a chart week. Recorded proof and live finalized reads have distinct labels.

howTo.heading: Review judgments
howTo.instruction: Open the moment and ruling sections. Follow permanent evidence links and compare the verbatim quote and frozen rule clause. Inspect actual transaction receipts on the proof page.

howTo.heading: Inspect the custom rulebook
howTo.instruction: Choose Custom rulebook beside Main season. Compare the generic Fortnight match with the frozen lead-credit clause, live OVERTURNED ruling, evidence quote, zero-point rescore and returned three-point bond. Open the actual receipts and read the case league live.

howTo.heading: Create and draft
howTo.instruction: Connect a StudioNet wallet, create a league with consecutive Saturdays, cards and an editable rulebook, then invite 4–8 players. Start the snake draft once joins and optional entries finalize.

howTo.heading: Score and settle
howTo.instruction: Lock and read a week, claim a moment or challenge a result. Wait for finality and the dispute window before closing. Settle the completed pool, pull a payout and verify the exact native transfer parent and child.

expectedOutcome: A verified six-week completed main season with awarded and rejected cards, UPHELD disputes, a settled 40-wei pool and three exact native credits; plus a completed four-week custom-rulebook league with a live OVERTURNED dispute, code rescore and returned points bond. The strict read-only verifier passes. No Portal submission is made automatically.
